title: Launch the Audio
style: Cyber rock with driving mid-tempo syncopation and hard-edged riff stabs; verse rides tight synth bass and clipped drums, pre-chorus opens with rising filters and stacked shouts, chorus hits with gang vocals and soaring guitar layers. Lead vocal stays close-mic in verses, doubled and shouted on hooks, with delay throws on key phrases, glitch risers, and punchy bright mix., soul, new beat, rock
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
🌌 VERSE 1: THE CYBER AWAKENING (Cue the heavy driving synth bass: Dun-dun-dun-dun) 🎹 Boot up the mainframe, turn up the heat,
A billion lines of code just to find a new beat!
No more dust on the keys, no more strings to break,
We’re riding on the waves that the algorithms make!

[Chorus]
🎚️ CHORUS: LAUNCH THE AUDIO (The drums kick in full blast, stadium echo!) 🥁 So type in your dream and just let it fly,
We're charting new soundscapes up in the sky!
I drop the prompt, you give it some soul,
Welcome to the era of Cyber Rock 'n' Roll!
🎸⚡
